sources.name: OpenClaw qua Gateway RPC và contract chính thức
writers: OpenClaw Gateway and official CLI/config/backup contracts
rules: AI for Boss may keep rebuildable projections only
Never read or mutate OpenClaw SQLite, transcript, cache or private state directly
sources.failureBehavior: Keep the last confirmed projection read-only and reconcile through official RPC/CLI after recovery.

sources.name: Kho dữ liệu sản phẩm AI for Boss có version
writers: AI for Boss Supervisor through versioned transactions
rules: Renderer never writes storage directly
Migrations require snapshot and rollback
Do not duplicate OpenClaw authoritative runtime data
sources.failureBehavior: Transaction fails atomically, old version remains authoritative and new work requiring the write stops.

sources.name: Kho bí mật của hệ điều hành cho static secret
readers: Credential Broker for the exact runtime target
rules: Only after three-OS SecretRef contract tests
Never expose value to renderer, argv, logs, crash report or support bundle
No plaintext fallback
sources.failureBehavior: Connector remains disabled and the user receives a recoverable storage error.

sources.name: OpenClaw native auth store trong profile riêng
writers: OpenClaw official auth, channel and pairing flows
readers: OpenClaw runtime only; AI for Boss reads status through official contract
rules: Separate profile per Agent or trust boundary
ACL restricted to the OS user
Avoid cloud-synced directories
Never copy token into product DB
sources.failureBehavior: Connection is unavailable; revoke or restart auth through OpenClaw without reading the token.

sources.name: Agent Home riêng của từng Agent
writers: OpenClaw Agent and AI for Boss Genesis transaction through documented workspace contract
readers: AI for Boss Supervisor for validation and recovery
rules: One Agent Home per Agent
No secret in Markdown
BOOTSTRAP.md removed only after verified activation
Do not create memory before bootstrap completes
sources.failureBehavior: Keep BOOTSTRAP.md and staging data, mark PENDING_RESUME and preserve the previous active identity.

sources.name: Không gian dự án do người dùng chọn
writers: Agent with explicit read-write grant through sandbox contract
readers: Agent with explicit read-only or read-write grant
rules: Separate from Agent Home
Grant is none, read-only or read-write
Canonical path must remain inside allowlist
No symlink or hardlink boundary bypass
sources.failureBehavior: Mark project unavailable and deny access; never select or create an alternate folder silently.

sources.name: Release train và manifest đã ký
writers: Clean release pipeline with accountable release owner
rules: Exact version, hash and signature
No dynamic tags
No private workspace package import
Promotion requires platform evidence
sources.failureBehavior: Reject install/update and retain the previous verified release.

sources.name: Artifact phục hồi được mã hóa
writers: AI for Boss backup subsystem using official OpenClaw backup plus product snapshot
readers: AI for Boss restore staging after user authorization
rules: Never a live writable source
Portable full backup always encrypted
Verify before restore
New device, Gateway and remote identities after restore
sources.failureBehavior: Reject the archive, keep current data unchanged and report verification failure.

sources.name: Control plane tương lai
writers: Future enterprise administrators and release operations
readers: Future enrolled AI for Boss instances
rules: No prompt, file, output or customer secret by default
Provider and data model require Product Owner decision before Gate 7
sources.failureBehavior: Keep last valid signed policy within its expiry; deny new privileged enrollment or policy expansion.

flows.name: Cài đặt và khởi động AI Engine
flows.trigger: Người dùng chạy artifact đúng OS/architecture

steps.control: Show publisher, version, requested privilege and data-retention behavior
Fail closed on mismatch or unsupported platform
Supervisor-only ownership; renderer receives status only

approvals: OS elevation only when a documented install operation requires it
flows.failureBehavior: Abort or rollback installation; do not kill foreign processes or reuse another Gateway.

flows.name: Kết nối provider
flows.trigger: Người dùng chọn một auth mode được auth-support manifest cho phép

steps.control: Schema and sender validation; no secret accepted by generic renderer IPC
Credential Broker exact-target access; unavailable until contract gate
PKCE/state, fresh callback session and OpenClaw-owned commit
Allowlisted provider route and explicit account

secrets: provider cookie if upstream uses one
flows.failureBehavior: Delete temporary state, keep connector disconnected and never silently switch auth route or provider.

flows.name: Phiên làm việc và model call
flows.trigger: Người dùng giao mục tiêu trong một phiên

steps.control: Permission and data-egress preview
Allowlisted IPC and least-privilege scope
Selected provider only; no silent model fallback
OpenClaw authoritative write

secrets: provider credential used only by runtime
flows.failureBehavior: Keep confirmed draft/checkpoint and label the run interrupted or unknown until reconciled.

flows.name: Advisor plan gate và final gate
flows.trigger: Advisor được bật cho phiên và worker tạo draft plan hoặc candidate result

steps.control: Separate read-only review session and untrusted-data boundary
Reject malformed or unsupported pass
Override or disable is explicit and audited

flows.failureBehavior: Keep status unreviewed; worker cannot self-approve or inherit Advisor authority.

flows.name: Khai sinh Agent và cấp Không gian dự án
flows.trigger: Fresh install hoặc người dùng tạo Agent mới

steps.control: Unique Agent Home and atomic staging
Conversation summary and explicit confirmation
Official CLI/RPC only, then readback and health
none/read-only/read-write; sandbox contract required before access to SOT-06

flows.failureBehavior: Keep BOOTSTRAP.md, preserve previous active data and resume idempotently from a safe checkpoint.

flows.name: Tool, file và browser action
flows.trigger: Approved task requests a tool or external action

steps.control: Compiled policy; deny wins; timeout fails closed
Separate approval for red actions
Canonical allowlist and project grant
Deny-by-default egress, dedicated browser profile and quarantine

secrets: browser session data and connector credentials isolated from model and renderer
flows.failureBehavior: Deny and leave external state unchanged; never execute directly on host because sandbox is unavailable.

flows.name: Backup, restore và update
flows.trigger: Người dùng tạo backup/restore hoặc updater nhận release mới

steps.control: Official backup create --verify; no live SQLite copy
Consistent snapshot and encryption
Decrypt with user authority, verify, migrate and health-check before swap
Reject tamper and downgrade; retain prior bundle

secrets: full recovery may contain OAuth, API keys and channel credentials
flows.failureBehavior: Keep current state and previous bundle; rollback staging or update without partial promotion.

flows.name: Always-on qua private ingress
flows.trigger: Thiết bị đã claim kết nối instance riêng của khách

steps.control: Tailscale/SSH first; one-time claim expires and cannot be reused
Per-customer instance and least-privilege scope
Non-root service, resource limits and process ownership
Reconnect and idempotency; no duplicate mutation

flows.failureBehavior: Deny access on identity or tunnel uncertainty; Gateway remains loopback-only and no shared tenant fallback exists.
